chapters.title: Chapter 401: The System Reveals the True Emotions of Five Princesses!
paragraphs: Rhaenyra entered with an angry expression, her crimson eyes immediately settling upon Luke.
"Huh? Why?"
Luke looked at her in confusion, momentarily forgetting that he had intended to thank her for saving his life.
Unfortunately, his innocent question only made Rhaenyra angrier.
"Huh?! Are you seriously asking me that?!"
She approached him and grabbed his collar, pulling him closer until they were looking directly into each other's eyes.

"I allowed you to wander around because I thought you would behave like an ordinary, docile human, but instead, you went around provoking an entire Orc tribe and nearly got yourself killed! And now you're asking me why I'm not letting you leave?!"
Luke couldn't immediately find an answer.
After all, her accusation wasn't entirely wrong.
Although he had attacked the Orc outposts because he desperately needed to advance his cultivation, that explanation didn't change the fact that he had nearly lost his life.
So he looked toward Rhaenyra.
"Sorry."
Rhaenyra immediately became silent.
She had expected him to argue, make some ridiculous excuse, or behave shamelessly as he usually did.
Instead, Luke had simply accepted his mistake.
Before she could respond, he continued.
"And thank you for saving my life."
This time, Rhaenyra was completely speechless.
The very human she had nearly killed during their earlier confrontation was now sincerely thanking her for saving him.
Luke noticed her silence and smiled.
"I knew I could trust my wife."
[Tch! Luke, you're playing with fire again.]
The System's familiar warning immediately appeared, although Luke ignored it.
Meanwhile, Emberlyn, who had been listening from behind, became startled upon hearing his words.
'Wife?'
She remembered how furious Rhaenyra had become when Luke called her that during their earlier encounter on the Human Continent.
'Isn't Big Sister going to hit him again?'
Emberlyn immediately became cautious, preparing to intervene if Rhaenyra attempted to attack him.
Fortunately, the expected punch never came.
Instead, Rhaenyra's furious voice echoed through the room.
"WHO IS YOUR WIFE?! I've already told you that someone weaker than me cannot become my husband!"
She released his collar before folding her arms.
"And I don't need a husband at all!"
"Hmph!"
Rhaenyra glared at the smiling human standing before her, feeling an increasingly strong urge to strangle him for acting so shamelessly.
Unfortunately, something was bothering her.
'Why can't I hit that face anymore?'
During their earlier encounter, she hadn't hesitated to attack Luke when his behavior angered her.
Yet now, despite his continued teasing, she found herself unable to raise her hand against him.
'Maybe it's because he only just recovered.'
Rhaenyra quickly offered herself that explanation, hoping it would settle the strange feeling.
However, deep down, she understood that something had changed.
Whether she had simply become softer toward Luke or couldn't bring herself to treat him the same way after kissing him during his treatment, she wasn't entirely certain.
"Okay."
Luke accepted her refusal without arguing, feeling rather pleased that his dragon wife hadn't attacked him again.
'Looks like her feelings really have changed.'
Unfortunately, there was another problem.
He genuinely needed to leave the palace.
"Hmm, Rhaenyra, I actually have something urgent to do, so I need to—"
"No means NO!"
Rhaenyra immediately interrupted him, glaring at him as though he were deliberately pretending not to understand her words.
Luke sighed.
'How am I supposed to deal with this woman?'
After considering the situation, he decided to examine the current emotional status of his wives.
A familiar System panel immediately appeared before him.
Wife #1 — Human Princess (Aurielle Valmont)
* Dependency: 100%
* Core Affection State: /Obsession/Possessive/Love/Trust/Dependency.
* Current Mood State: Worried.
* Inner thoughts: {Is Luke safe now?}
Wife #2 — Elf Princess (Elaria Moonleaf)
* Dependency: 0%
* Core Affection State: Neutral.
* Current Mood State: Calm.
* Inner thoughts: {Seems like that human survived.}
Wife #3 — Dragon Princess (Rhaenyra Crimsonscale)
* Dependency: 0%
* Core Affection State: Like.
* Current Mood State: Worried.
* Inner thoughts: {Should I kidnap him again and lock him somewhere else?}
Wife #4 — Mermaid Princess (Naivara Tidewhisper)
* Dependency: 0%
* Core Affection State: Like.
* Current Mood State: Worried.
* Inner thoughts: {Is Luke safe now?}
Wife #5 — Vampire Princess (Selene Nightveil)
* Dependency: 50%
* Core Affection State: Natal-Yandere/Obsession/Possessive/Love/Trust/Dependency.
{Warning, host is suggested to make healthy yandere, but the current natal yandere is going towards host death, due to Selene's jealousy.}
* Current Mood State: Worried.
* Inner thoughts: {Is Luke safe now? I shouldn't have let him run away earlier!}
After so many days without checking his wives' statuses, Luke was surprised to discover several changes, although a few of them didn't seem quite right.

'System, is that warning in Selene's section actually true?' he asked, focusing entirely on the warning rather than the disturbing fact that an healthy yandere could even end up killing the person she loved.
[Of course it's true. You should take care of her more.]
'Okay.'

Luke acknowledged the warning but decided not to dwell on it for now, since Selene was far away, while Rhaenyra was standing directly in front of him with an angry expression that didn't match the emotions displayed by the System.
'So she's faking it?'
He looked at Rhaenyra again, finding it rather strange that despite her apparent anger, her actual mood was worried, and she was even considering kidnapping him again and locking him away somewhere.
However, as Luke continued examining her status, he finally noticed something that surprised him even more.
'Wait, she actually likes me now?'
His attention remained on the Core Affection State: Like, and although he was pleased by the discovery, he couldn't understand how her feelings had changed so much.
'Really? But why?'
After thinking about it for a moment, Luke recalled something the System had previously explained regarding the golden chains.

According to the System, whenever one of his wives developed even the slightest curiosity or any other positive emotion toward him, the golden chains would silently amplify those feelings over time, gradually strengthening them and making the changes permanent.
However, this effect was different from the temporary emotional amplification that sometimes occurred as a side effect of the chains.
'Hmm, that seems like the only possibility,' Luke concluded, completely unaware of the actual reason behind Rhaenyra's growing feelings.
Nevertheless, when he looked at her again, he could now recognize the worry hidden beneath her angry expression, which made him reconsider how he should approach the situation.
"Okay, Rhaenyra, then here's what I need. I want to visit a place where lightning strikes most frequently, and you can accompany me there."
Hearing his unusual request, both Emberlyn and Rhaenyra became confused, wondering why he suddenly wanted to visit such a place immediately after recovering.
"Why do you need to go there?" Emberlyn asked from behind him, prompting Luke to turn toward her with a smile.
"You'll find out soon."

Emberlyn's mouth twitched upon hearing his answer, since during the month she had spent accompanying Luke, she had already discovered how much he enjoyed keeping secrets, especially whenever he was planning to do something unusual.
Meanwhile, Rhaenyra considered his request for a moment before finally giving her answer.
"Okay, but you aren't allowed to run around freely," she said angrily, making it clear that she had no intention of letting him wander off on his own again.
Hearing her agreement, Luke immediately nodded, a teasing smile appearing on his face as he replied, "As my wife wishes."
'Cheeky brat.'
"Hmph."
Ignoring his shameless behavior, Rhaenyra turned away and walked outside, deciding to wait for Luke to finish whatever preparations he needed to make before they departed together.

chapters.title: Chapter 402: Luke Asks to Ride His Dragon Wife?!
paragraphs: After leaving the palace, Luke, Rhaenyra, and Emberlyn were flying through the sky, with Luke relying on his wings while both Dragon Princesses traveled in their original dragon forms.
FWOOOSH!
Rhaenyra gracefully flapped her wings as she flew forward, occasionally attracting Luke's attention as he traveled beside her.
'Damn, is this the natural beauty that dragons possess?'
He couldn't help admiring her appearance, especially since, despite not being in a into beastly interest, he found something strangely beautiful about her dragon scales and elegant movements.
The way Rhaenyra moved through the open sky reminded him of a swan gliding freely through the air, carrying a natural grace that made every movement appear effortless.
However, while Luke was admiring her appearance, his gaze eventually moved toward her broad back, which was completely empty.
And without thinking much about the implications, he casually asked.
"Rhaenyra, can I ride you?"
[Oh boy, already thinking of riding her. As expected of the womanizer. b(^_^) — Thumbs up]
Luke ignored the System's teasing, although the same couldn't be said for the two Dragon Princesses, who immediately turned their heads toward him with expressions of disbelief.
And Emberlyn's dragon face developed a visible blush upon hearing his words, while Rhaenyra responded in an extremely cold voice.
"If you want to die, feel free."
Hearing that threatening response, Luke immediately shut his mouth, unable to understand why asking for a ride had become such a serious matter.
However, Emberlyn was once again surprised that her elder sister hadn't beaten him, especially considering how inappropriate his request sounded to dragons.
After all, among their race, allowing someone to ride upon a dragon's back was something that simply wasn't permitted, regardless of who that person might be.
The only exception involved intercourse, during which a male partner could ride upon the female dragon's back.
Therefore, when Luke casually asked whether he could ride Rhaenyra, his words carried practically the same implication as directly asking her to have sex with him.

Unfortunately, this was nothing more than a misunderstanding, since Luke was simply thinking about the dragon riders he had encountered in novels and wanted to experience what it would feel like to ride an actual dragon.
"Keep flying, and if you open your mouth again, then I'll break both your jaws."
After delivering that warning, Rhaenyra increased her flying speed, forcing Luke, who had already been struggling to keep up with the two Dragon Princesses, to work even harder.
'Tch! Why are you getting angry?'
He decided to ignore her unnecessary anger and concentrated on manipulating the wind element surrounding his wings, using it to increase his flying speed.
FWOOOSHHH!
With the additional assistance of the wind, Luke accelerated through the sky and continued following the two princesses.

After traveling for five hours, the three finally arrived at a valley filled with thousands of elongated hills, while numerous blackened trees stood along the lower ground, their branches completely devoid of leaves.
Above the valley, thick dark clouds stretched across the sky, with frequent flashes of lightning illuminating their interiors.
"This place looks good."
Luke nodded in satisfaction as he observed the large concentration of thunderclouds hanging above the hills, feeling that he had finally found a suitable location to complete his breakthrough.
However, upon seeing his pleased expression, the System couldn't help sighing.
[He still hasn't found out? He's going to summon a real tribulation cloud.]
According to the System, if Luke's EX-Rank foundation-building technique had progressed normally, the natural lightning present in this valley would have been sufficient to complete his advancement.
Unfortunately, because he had obtained Rhaenyra's Blood Essence along with the karma associated with her existence, his cultivation had attracted Valtharion's attention.
Although his existence hadn't been completely exposed, the Valtharion laws had already detected enough of an irregularity to interfere with his breakthrough.
Otherwise, if everything about him had been exposed, the punishment wouldn't have been limited to an ordinary tribulation, since divine thunder itself could have descended upon him.

The System looked toward the sky, where it could already perceive a single gigantic golden eye gradually taking shape, although the eye remained invisible to everyone else and its eyelid was still closed.
This was also one of the reasons Luke's Titan spirits hadn't awakened after falling asleep during the previous battle.
If Valtharion detected their presence while Luke was undergoing his breakthrough, its wrath toward those Titans might also be transferred to him, making an already dangerous situation even worse.
Meanwhile, after returning to her humanoid form, Emberlyn approached Luke and curiously asked.
"So what were you about to do?"
Not far away, Rhaenyra had also returned to her humanoid appearance and was currently sitting near a boulder, silently listening to their conversation.
Luke looked toward the dark clouds overhead before casually answering.
"Nothing, just that I have to take all of those lightnings head-on."
Both Dragon Princesses immediately fell silent, their gazes shifting toward the thunderclouds, where lightning continued crackling with enough power to make even higher-ranked beings cautious.
After all, many of those lightning strikes possessed B-Rank strength, while a smaller number carried attack power comparable to A-Rank.
Yet Luke, who was still only D-Rank, had casually announced that he intended to endure them directly.
"Okay ladies, wait for me."
After saying that, Luke removed his shirt, revealing his well-defined chest and abdomen, which immediately attracted Emberlyn's attention.
A slight blush appeared on her cheeks, and although she occasionally turned her face away, she couldn't help stealing another glance at his exposed upper body.
Unfortunately, Rhaenyra noticed her younger sister's behavior.
'Shameless.'
She inwardly cursed Luke for casually removing his shirt in front of them, clearly holding him responsible for the embarrassing situation.
Meanwhile, Luke paid little attention to their reactions and headed toward the highest cliff in the valley.

After reaching the summit, he sat down and began waiting for the lightning, although he hadn't forgotten the System's earlier warning that the strength of the attacks involved in his breakthrough would be considerably greater than expected.
Naturally, he needed to consider how he would withstand such powerful lightning while still being a D-Rank existence.
Just as he was thinking about his preparations, the System finally spoke.
[Ahem, Luke, there will be a little change in the lightning tribulation.]
Hearing those words, Luke paused, not immediately understanding what the System meant.
[Well, when I said earlier that the lightning attack power would reach A rank, I meant a tribulation lightning, not a normal A rank lightning.]
Luke's mouth twitched as he finally understood what the System was trying to tell him.
"And you didn't tell me this earlier."
He was clearly dissatisfied, especially since he knew that tribulation lightning was completely different from an ordinary attack of the same rank.
"So Valtharion would be involved?"
[Yes.]
The System answered in a lower voice, causing Luke to release a helpless sigh.

After all, his previous experiences involving Valtharion had hardly been pleasant, and he understood perfectly well that if the world's will became genuinely furious with him, he could very well lose his life.
Fortunately, the System's next words gave him a little hope.
[Though, as your technique stated, this lightning is nothing but a formality, that you got acknowledged, while your foundation is perfect.]
[So you will only face a single lightning, that normally A rank beings face during their tribulation.]

chapters.title: Chapter 403: Heaven Forge—The Birth of Defensive Forged Arts!
paragraphs: The System didn't explain much about the tribulations ordinarily experienced by A-Rank beings, although Luke understood that he would still have to endure an actual A-Rank tribulation lightning strike.
"Well, if it's single then I would be fine."
He muttered those words without feeling entirely confident, but at least knowing that he would face only one strike allowed him to prepare accordingly.
With that thought, Luke immediately activated the fusion between Nyx and Azrion, transforming into Vorthar.
"Hah."
Within moments, a seventy-foot-tall Titan appeared upon the cliff, his entire body covered from head to toe in the pure-white Nullex Armor.
Even after transforming, Luke remained seated with his legs crossed, preparing to use another ability that he had recently obtained.
"Time to use Heaven Forge again."
This time, he was placing his hopes upon the Anvil Titan's Origin Authority, intending to go beyond merely combining his existing techniques in the conventional manner.

As his power began circulating, a solidified phantom of an anvil appeared behind his back, followed by the manifestation of a blacksmith's hammer, which hovered above it as though waiting for the forging process to begin.
"First, Defensive Forged Arts — Two Components."
Luke muttered those words before raising his hand and beginning to construct the first defensive technique.
"Heavenly Fortress"
"Fortress Wall + Cosmic Construct!"
KLANG! CLANG! KLANG! CLANG!
The phantom hammer immediately began striking the anvil, producing a series of metallic sounds as Luke's energy gathered above it and condensed into a sphere.
With every strike, the energy underwent further changes, gradually merging Bastion's defensive Aether with Caelith's solidified Cosmic Energy.
After several strikes, the forging process finally reached completion, and the newly created energy expanded outward, forming a reinforced protective dome around Luke.

Unlike an ordinary Fortress Wall, the resulting barrier possessed both the defensive properties of Bastion's Aether and the physical solidity of Caelith's cosmic constructs, allowing the two different powers to function as a single defensive structure.
Luke examined the completed dome, which now covered the hill upon which he was seated, and nodded with satisfaction.
He then turned his attention toward his internal energy circulation and replaced both of his hearts with Cosmic Hearts, something he could accomplish because of Titan Harmony.

Moreover, ever since his Eternal Titan Zero reconstruction progress had reached 99.99%, the effects of Titan Harmony had become even more effective, allowing him to make better use of such combinations.

KLANG! CLANG! KLANG! CLANG!

"Mountain's Shell + Earthbound!"

This made it exceptionally difficult for outside forces to push, lift, or knock him backward, allowing him to maintain his position even when confronted by powerful physical impacts.
The combination was particularly effective when Luke remained in contact with the ground, where the earth-anchoring properties could provide their greatest benefit.

Since his objective was to survive the coming A-Rank tribulation, Luke continued forging additional defensive Arts, intending to strengthen his protection while retaining the ability to move under the lightning's bombardment.
One after another, new combinations began taking shape.
"Invisible Fortress"
"Null Veil of Nyx + Fortress Wall!"
This time, Luke forged Nyx's stealth Authority into Bastion's defensive barrier, creating a concealed dome that could hide both its structure and the area protected within it.
Unlike an ordinary barrier, the completed Forged Art incorporated Null Veil's concealment properties, making it difficult for outside observers to perceive what lay inside.

Luke was particularly interested in this combination because it involved an Authority rather than ordinary stealth magic, and he hoped that even the tribulation lightning might have difficulty locating his actual body within the concealed barrier.

Whether such a method could truly deceive Valtharion remained uncertain, but he saw no reason not to prepare it. However he let it remain off for now and would on, when he would about to go tribulation.
Afterward, Luke immediately began constructing another defense.
"Closure Barrier"
"Fortress Wall + Seal of Closure!"

paragraphs: By combining Bastion's protective barrier with Sevaroth's Closure Authority, Luke created a defensive structure capable of sealing cracks and openings produced by attacks.
Normally, such a combination could be used to repair damage after a barrier had already been struck.
However, Luke didn't intend to wait until an attack damaged the shield before manually activating the sealing effect.
Instead, he directly connected his energy circulation to the forged structure, allowing the Closure Authority to respond automatically whenever cracks appeared.
As long as he could supply sufficient energy, the barrier would attempt to seal those openings before the damage spread further.
"And finally."
Luke checked his energy reserves once more and discovered that they were still overflowing, especially since most of the Forged Arts he had created so far involved combinations of only two abilities.
Consequently, he decided to prepare one final defensive technique.
"Unshaken Aegis"
"Bastion's Aegis + Iron Will!"
Under Luke's control, Heaven Forge began combining Bastion's powerful protective barrier with the mental resistance provided by Iron Will.

Once the forging was completed, the resulting defense possessed protection against physical, magical, spiritual, and mind-affecting attacks, allowing the two original abilities to function as a single defensive phenomenon.

Iron Will was already an excellent ability against mental interference, and by incorporating it into Bastion's Aegis, Luke hoped that even the spiritual properties carried by the coming lightning tribulation wouldn't be able to bypass his will.
With the completion of this final Forged Art, several layers of protection now surrounded his seventy-foot Titan body, each possessing different defensive properties.
Meanwhile, the two Dragon Princesses had been watching the entire process from their position below the cliff, and their expressions had gradually become increasingly incredulous.
"What the heck? Is he even human?"
Emberlyn couldn't help muttering those words as she observed the numerous defensive barriers Luke had created.
Although she already knew that Luke possessed extraordinary abilities, witnessing him casually bring out so many different defenses had still exceeded her expectations.

After all, even as an A-Rank Dragon, she could confidently say that those protective layers were sufficient to withstand an ordinary A-Rank attack, with the possibility that several barriers would remain intact afterward.
Rhaenyra was similarly surprised, although her attention was particularly drawn toward the last defensive technique.
She raised an eyebrow as she examined the barrier surrounding Luke, recognizing that it possessed an unusual resistance to mental interference.
Such abilities were comparatively rare, and they were especially valuable when dealing with demons, whose attacks could often involve spiritual or mental manipulation.
However, just as Emberlyn was wondering whether Luke could still be considered human, a gentle voice accompanied by soft laughter suddenly came from behind them.
"No, he is a titan."
"Grandma!"
Both Dragon Princesses immediately turned around upon hearing the familiar voice, recognizing its owner even before looking at her face.
Standing behind them was their grandmother, Zephyrielle, who approached the two sisters with an amused smile.
"Ahh, my little princesses have become mature in a few days, while I was gone."
She came closer and affectionately embraced both of them, her teasing words clearly referring to the Luke they had been watching so attentively.
"Ahem."
Rhaenyra immediately pretended not to understand the implication, while Emberlyn's cheeks developed a faint blush upon hearing her grandmother's remark.
Noticing her younger granddaughter's embarrassment, Zephyrielle merely smiled and gently rubbed her hair.
However, Emberlyn was still curious about something she had heard earlier.
"Grandma, what's a titan?"
Hearing the question, Zephyrielle looked toward Luke's seventy-foot body, which remained seated upon the distant cliff while surrounded by the defensive barriers he had created.
"Titan is a race. And your little lover is a titan."
She answered with a smile, deliberately avoiding mentioning which of her granddaughters she was teasing.
Unfortunately, both Rhaenyra and Emberlyn understood the implication and instinctively avoided meeting her gaze.
"But isn't Luke human? After all, he was sum—"
"Yes, he was human when he came to Valtharion, but now he isn't human anymore, but a titan."
Zephyrielle interrupted Rhaenyra before she could finish her question, calmly clarifying what she meant.
However, rather than resolving their confusion, her answer only raised additional questions.
Both Dragon Princesses turned toward Luke again, watching as he continued preparing more defensive barriers around himself.
"Then Grandma, why haven't we heard about the titan race?"
Zephyrielle gently rubbed their hair before answering, a faint smile appearing on her face as her thoughts wandered toward certain old memories.
"Well, the records of the titan race were erased from the mainlands, which is the result you never heard."
Hearing that explanation, both princesses became shocked.

After all, erasing the records of an entire race from the mainlands was no small accomplishment, especially when considering how many kingdoms, empires, and ancient civilizations existed throughout Valtharion.
Zephyrielle noticed their reactions and continued explaining what she knew.
"When your grandpa went to the Endless Forest, he found an ancient tomb, and that tomb belonged to an old titan."
She paused briefly, recalling how surprised she herself had been when her husband first told her about the discovery.
"In these records, the titan said that while they were on the mainlands, their bodies were so large that even dragons of today time would looks like dwarfs in front of them."
"Really??"
Emberlyn was genuinely shocked by that claim, finding it difficult to believe that another race could possess bodies so much larger than dragons.
After all, dragons were widely known for possessing some of the largest physical forms among the races of Valtharion.
Even an S-Rank dragon could grow several kilometers long, while their grandfather's dragon form was on an entirely different scale, extending for hundreds of kilometers.

Emberlyn had even heard stories that whenever their grandfather traveled over a kingdom in his original dragon form, the entire territory would temporarily fall into darkness because his body was large enough to block the sunlight.
And now her grandmother was claiming that ancient Titans had been so large that even dragons appeared like dwarfs in comparison.
"Haha, yes, even I was surprised, but when your grandpa found the tomb, that titan's body was so large that even he with his strength couldn't be able to lift it up."
O_O

Both Dragon Princesses immediately opened their mouths in disbelief, unable to imagine how a dead Titan's body could be so heavy that even their grandfather couldn't lift it with his extraordinary strength.
However, Zephyrielle ignored their stunned expressions and continued recounting what the ancient records had revealed.
"In that record, the titan said that using their physical strength, they had defeated every being. Even with their demigod cultivation, they had defeated the gods."
"Grandma, that's absurd!"
This time, even Rhaenyra couldn't remain silent, since her grandmother's explanation was becoming increasingly difficult to accept.
After all, a demigod was still only a demigod, while a true god possessed divinity and existed on an entirely different level of power.
So how could a Titan who had cultivated only physical strength defeat an actual god while remaining at the demigod stage?
Zephyrielle understood her granddaughter's disbelief, although she continued explaining what had been recorded inside the ancient tomb.

"Well, it was said by that old titan, that they only cultivated their physical bodies. So when at the demigod stage, their body's physical damage and divinity were linked. So for them, a punch carrying divinity, or a punch carrying an elemental attack, or a punch carrying physical strength, was the same."
"Which means, for any type of attack, they had to pass through their physical defense before they could be killed."

chapters.title: Chapter 405: Gods and Mortals United to Exterminate the Titans?! [GT Bonus Chapter]
paragraphs: Zephyrielle continued before either princess could interrupt.

"But here is the twist, as titans were known for the greatest physical strength, so even gods failed to kill them, which resulted in those titans overwhelming the gods after their divinity reserves got empty."
According to those records, the ancient Titans could endure attacks that would ordinarily overwhelm beings at the same cultivation level.
However, another question immediately appeared in Emberlyn's mind.
"If that was true, then how did they disappear?"
After all, if the ancient Titans had been powerful enough to defeat actual gods, she couldn't understand what kind of existence could have forced their race to vanish from the mainlands.
Zephyrielle looked at her younger granddaughter before answering.
"When one person or one race becomes too strong, then other forces always combine their forces to erase them."
Hearing those words, both sisters widened their eyes, immediately understanding what their grandmother was implying.
They had been so focused on the extraordinary power of the ancient Titans that they had overlooked the possibility of multiple forces joining together against them.
Zephyrielle continued explaining the events described within the tomb.
"So even before the twilight era, the fall of gods, there was a world-shattering battle that occurred, where all gods and all races combined and hunted the titans."
"But those titans, who weren't known for their cowardice, fought to the end, taking many gods with them."
"Sadly, seeing that even their titan race was about to go extinct, they finally chose to flee."
"So in simple words, the gods or the mainland had forced those titans from here."
"After escaping, no one ever saw a titan on the surface, and even their records were erased by the gods."

After listening to her grandmother's explanation, both Rhaenyra and Emberlyn remained silent for several moments, trying to digest the information concerning a race that had supposedly fought against the combined forces of gods and other civilizations.
However, one particular detail still didn't seem right.
"While this was happening, where was the god of the titan race?"
The question immediately attracted Zephyrielle's attention, although her expression suggested that she had already considered the same possibility.
"That's the most weird thing, because in the record your grandpa found, there wasn't a single time mentioned of a god, like the titans never had a god born in their race."
"What? This strong race, even after getting so many resources, couldn't produce a single god?"
"Unbelievable!"
Both princesses found that explanation difficult to accept, especially considering how powerful the Titans had supposedly become despite cultivating only their physical bodies.
However, Zephyrielle could only smile at their disbelief, since she herself didn't know whether that particular part of the ancient record was completely true.
After all, only the Titans themselves could know the full history of their race.
Meanwhile, Emberlyn recalled something her grandmother had mentioned earlier and decided to ask another question.
"Then Grandma, why are you saying Luke is a titan? After all, he never got in contact with any titan."

Although Emberlyn had witnessed Luke transform into powerful giant forms and display extraordinary physical strength, she still found it difficult to believe that he belonged to the same race described in her grandmother's story.
After all, Luke had originally arrived in Valtharion as a human, and as far as she knew, he had never encountered an actual Titan.
Zephyrielle smiled at her confusion.
"Well, you forgot one thing, my little princess."
After saying that, she paused and raised her head toward the sky before continuing.
"Your little lover is a hero."
"And a hero is connected by the gods."
Hearing those words, both Rhaenyra and Emberlyn exchanged glances, finally understanding what their grandmother was suggesting.
It means, his goddess had transformed him into a Titan in order to grant him greater strength.
After all, every god and goddess naturally wanted their chosen Hero to become as powerful as possible, making that explanation seem reasonable to them.
However, Emberlyn still had another question concerning the race that had supposedly disappeared from the mainlands.
"But Grandma, where are those titans now?"
"Hmm, those titans and many other races are currently living at the land beyond the Endless Sea."
Zephyrielle answered before continuing with the reason behind her conclusion.
"Because the titan tomb your grandpa found mentioned that he, after surviving many dangers in his journey, was returning back to the mainland to claim their homelands back."
"And this proves that there was another land beyond the Endless Seas, and the Endless Forest had the path to it."
After explaining that, Zephyrielle paused, recalling that the other demi-gods also had discovered several other ancient tombs and ruins within the Endless Forest.
Some of those remains had belonged to other races, and the records found within them also suggested that their owners had been attempting to return to the mainlands.
Unfortunately, every known attempt had ended in failure.

Even so, the fact that those beings had managed to cross the mysterious lands beyond the Endless Sea and reach the Endless Forest was already an extraordinary accomplishment. And only after this, the rumor spread, that there was land beyond the mainlands.
And while Zephyrielle was considering those discoveries, something suddenly changed in the sky above the lightning valley.
An enormous golden eye appeared high above the clouds, its presence immediately altering the atmosphere surrounding the entire region.
"What!!!
Zephyrielle became completely shocked upon recognizing the eye, unable to understand why Valtharion itself had suddenly appeared in this place.
After all, Valtharion rarely involved itself directly in the affairs of living beings unless the circumstances concerned forbidden existences or demigods.
"Grandma, what's happening?"
Both Emberlyn and Rhaenyra looked toward their grandmother with worried expressions, as they hadn't recognized that the golden eye belonged to Valtharion.
However, Zephyrielle didn't immediately answer their question.
Instead, she attempted to use her own power to communicate with the star and discover why Valtharion had appeared above the valley.
Unfortunately, the moment she tried probing into that secret—
"Ahhhh!"
Zephyrielle suddenly cried out in pain, and blood began flowing from her tightly closed eyes.
"Grandma!"
Both Dragon Princesses immediately became alarmed and hurried forward, supporting their grandmother before she could lose her balance.
"I am fine."
Zephyrielle reassured them, although her expression remained filled with horror as she recalled what had just happened.
In her haste, she had forgotten that even though she was a demigod, her strength was utterly insignificant before Valtharion, an existence powerful enough to overwhelm even actual gods.

chapters.title: Chapter 406: Luke Has Only Ten Seconds to Survive Heaven's Judgment!
paragraphs: "Sealed Celestial Citadel"
"Cosmic Construct + Fortress Wall + Seal of Suppression!"

This time, Luke immediately felt his energy being drained at an alarming rate, but fortunately, his two Cosmic Hearts continued supplying enough energy for Heaven Forge to complete the formation of the energy sphere and merge all three abilities into a single defensive technique.

The result was a fortified cosmic enclosure whose surface possessed Sevaroth's Suppression Authority, allowing it to interfere with the lightning's power whenever the attack attempted to penetrate the barrier or manifest its energy through the structure.
"Hmm, the starting energy is getting higher."
Luke couldn't help muttering those words as he examined his remaining energy, realizing that the consumption had increased considerably compared to his previous attempts.

If his total energy reserves were represented by ten units, then forging a defensive Art with two components would consume approximately two to three units at once, which wasn't particularly troublesome because his Cosmic Hearts could instantly replenish that amount.
However, the three-component Forged Art had consumed nearly six to seven units, making the difference rather obvious.

That also meant he couldn't afford to create a defensive Art using four components, since the initial consumption might reach fifteen units, exceeding his available reserves before his Cosmic Hearts could replenish them.
Moreover, even if he somehow managed to maintain the necessary energy supply, his current concentration wouldn't be sufficient to control such a complicated forging process.
Realizing that attempting anything beyond three components would be too risky, Luke abandoned the idea and focused on strengthening his existing defenses.

He first created another "Severance Shield", although this time he used Fortress Wall and Energy Severance instead of Physical Severance, giving the new barrier the ability to interfere directly with incoming energy-based attacks.
After completing that combination, he turned his attention toward one final defensive Art, hoping it would provide additional protection against the coming tribulation.
"Shadow Guardian Covenant"
"Shadow of Nyx + Null Veil + Cosmic Construct!"
As the three abilities entered Heaven Forge, the phantom hammer began striking the gathered energy, gradually merging their properties until a new shadow being emerged from the completed Forged Art.
Unlike an ordinary Shadow of Nyx clone, this creation didn't resemble Luke.

Instead, a hundred-foot-tall guardian appeared before him, its entire body enveloped in the Void Energy of Null Veil, concealing its outer appearance so completely that its physical features were practically unrecognizable.
Immediately afterward, solidified cosmic matter formed around the guardian and enclosed its body within a protective suit of armor, providing an additional layer of defense against incoming attacks.
"It can act as a decoy."
Luke examined the newly created guardian, intending to direct the lightning toward it first so that the attack would expend some of its power before reaching his actual body.

Meanwhile, Zephyrielle had been observing his preparations alongside her two granddaughters, and even she couldn't help feeling surprised by the number of defensive techniques Luke had managed to create.

After all, according to the words she had from her husband, Titans were beings who relied primarily on their extraordinary physical bodies to withstand attacks, yet Luke was behaving completely differently by continuously crafting defensive techniques with abilities she couldn't even recognize.
'All of this seems higher-rank techniques.'
The thought immediately appeared in Zephyrielle's mind, although she soon recalled that Luke was still only D-Rank, while the tribulation awaiting him possessed A-Rank power.
'Hmm, normally the titan could bear higher-level attack with their body alone.'
Considering the difference between those two ranks, Zephyrielle understood why Luke was preparing so many defensive methods instead of relying entirely on his physical strength.
With that realization, she stopped questioning his unusual approach and continued watching alongside Rhaenyra and Emberlyn as the thunderclouds above the valley began swirling.
Meanwhile, upon the highest cliff, Luke had finally completed his preparations and was ready to begin his breakthrough.
He immediately directed his will toward his EX-Rank cultivation technique, informing it that he was prepared to face the tribulation.
The moment his intention was received, the reconstruction progress that had remained stuck at 99.99999% finally changed.
RUMMBLE!!!

A deafening thunderclap erupted across the sky, and an exceptionally thick bolt of golden lightning suddenly shot out from Valtharion's enormous eye, descending directly toward the Shadow Guardian standing before Luke.
Seeing the approaching attack, the hundred-foot-tall guardian immediately crossed both arms before its chest, preparing to withstand the incoming lightning with its cosmic armor.
However, the moment the golden bolt struck—
BOOOOOM!
A catastrophic explosion erupted as the lightning tore through the guardian without slowing down, instantly reducing its shadow body and cosmic defenses to smithereens.

Even after destroying the decoy, the lightning continued descending toward Luke, who remained seated upon the hill beneath his protective barriers, clearly demonstrating that neither the guardian nor his concealed defenses had diverted the attack from its intended target.
"Well, at least it consumed some energy."
Luke muttered those words without showing any disappointment, since he had never expected the Shadow Guardian to completely withstand such a powerful attack.

He immediately prepared to use everything he had during the next ten seconds, knowing that the approaching tribulation wasn't a continuous lightning channel but a single strike, meaning he wouldn't receive another opportunity to defend himself once it reached his body.
Rising from his seated position, Luke exhaled heavily.
"Hah!"

He then raised both hands toward the protective dome overhead, positioning himself as though he intended to support the entire structure with his own strength, before shouting loudly enough for everyone present to hear.
"ABSOLUTE STRENGTH!!!"
FWOOOSHHH!
The instant those words left his mouth, the muscles throughout Luke's seventy-foot Vorthar body expanded, causing his already powerful physique to grow even more imposing from head to toe.
The sudden increase in strength released a violent shockwave that erupted outward in every direction, sweeping across the surrounding air before colliding with the descending golden lightning.
Unfortunately, the lightning didn't even flinch upon meeting the shockwave, effortlessly tearing through it as it continued toward Luke.
Witnessing another sudden increase in his strength, both Rhaenyra and Emberlyn became shocked.
"How many methods does he have?"
The two Dragon Princesses could clearly sense the extraordinary physical aura radiating from Luke's body, and for a moment, the being standing upon the cliff no longer felt like an ordinary mortal.

His muscles now carried such concentrated strength that he seemed like an existence who had reached an extraordinary understanding of physical cultivation, causing his raw power to surge far beyond what either princess had expected.
"Hmm? Peak B rank?"
Zephyrielle muttered with considerable surprise, having already lost count of how many times her grandson-in-law had astonished her.
However, after examining him more carefully, another question immediately appeared in her mind.
"From where is he getting that much strength? And how can his D rank body be able to bear this?"

After all, even though Luke had transformed into a giant Titan, Zephyrielle could clearly sense that his life level still belonged to D-Rank, despite the extraordinary amount of energy circulating throughout his body and the increasingly refined condition of his muscles.

Every living being was born with certain restrictions that prevented its body from accumulating strength beyond what its existence could naturally withstand, since exceeding those boundaries would violate the laws governing cultivation.

chapters.title: Chapter 407: Five Seconds Left... Can Luke Survive?!
paragraphs: Although individuals possessing exceptional talents or blessings could sometimes surpass those restrictions, even they eventually encountered limits that couldn't be ignored.
Yet Luke was continuously pushing beyond those boundaries, displaying physical strength that should have been impossible for a being at his current life level.
Before Zephyrielle could understand how he was accomplishing this, another shout erupted from within the protective dome.
"COME!"
Luke roared toward the descending lightning, showing no hesitation as he prepared to confront Valtharion's power for the second time.

After all, he had already survived its wrath once before, and he intended to survive again today, firmly believing that a day would eventually arrive when their positions would be reversed, with him becoming the one attacking while Valtharion would be forced to endure his power.
RUMMBLLLLEEEE!
"HAHHHH!"
The next moment, the golden lightning finally collided with the first defensive layer.
"Heavenly Fortress"

The reinforced cosmic dome shattered almost immediately, unable to withstand the overwhelming force of the A-Rank tribulation, but when the lightning reached the second barrier, "Severance Shield", its momentum was abruptly disrupted.
The Physical Severance contained within the shield cut into the descending attack, stripping away a considerable portion of its force before the barrier itself was destroyed.
Immediately afterward, the lightning encountered the third defensive layer, another "Severance Shield", although this one possessed Energy Severance instead of its physical counterpart.

As the golden bolt struck its surface, the Severance Authority activated against the lightning's energy, cutting away approximately one-tenth of its remaining power while the other nine-tenths continued descending.
Both Severance Shields were destroyed during the collision, but their combined effects had successfully weakened the tribulation before it could reach Luke's other defenses.
"Ugh!"
Luke felt the backlash from their destruction, yet he refused to retreat, especially since the ten-second duration of Absolute Strength had already begun counting down.

Only eight seconds remained, but during that time, his enhanced physical attributes and energy output had also increased the amount of energy produced by his two Cosmic Hearts, allowing the defensive barriers he had already created to become stronger.
That additional supply was one of the reasons his Severance Shields had managed to cut away a portion of the A-Rank lightning instead of being destroyed without accomplishing anything.
Although the golden bolt had become somewhat dimmer, it continued descending and soon collided with the fourth layer.
"Celestial Gravity Shield"
This time, the defensive Art displayed the unique properties created by combining Cosmic Lock with Cosmic Construct.

Rather than pulling the lightning in a single direction, the gravitational field surrounding the barrier began dragging its energy outward from multiple directions simultaneously, subjecting the descending bolt to opposing forces.
Under that intense gravitational pressure, portions of the lightning's outer energy layer were stripped away, separating into smaller golden sparks that scattered toward the surrounding terrain.
BOOOM!

Even those fragments contained power comparable to Peak B-Rank attacks, causing violent explosions as they struck the ground and destroyed the nearby trees and hills, leaving only Luke's protected position standing amid the devastation.
"Is this real!"
Emberlyn instinctively covered her mouth, finding it difficult to believe that Luke had already managed to weaken an A-Rank tribulation to such an extent.
However, after watching his defenses operate one after another, she finally began understanding his approach.

Luke wasn't attempting to withstand the entire tribulation through raw physical strength, since he wasn't an A-Rank being himself, but was instead using different defensive methods to gradually reduce the attack's power before it reached his body.
"He knows what he is doing."
Rhaenyra muttered those words, feeling somewhat impressed by the preparations Luke had made.
Initially, she had expected him to rely primarily on absolute physical strength, especially since that was how she herself would prepare for such an attack.
Even Emberlyn had assumed something similar after witnessing Luke's battles against the Orcs, where he had repeatedly used powerful techniques to overwhelm his opponents.

However, the current situation was different, since every defensive Art surrounding Luke was already powerful enough to resist attacks approaching Peak B-Rank, yet each appeared comparatively weak against the A-Rank lightning descending from Valtharion.
Of course, watching him wield so many extraordinary abilities made it easy to forget one important detail about his actual cultivation.
"A D Rank."
Zephyrielle quietly muttered those words, reminding herself that the being currently resisting an A-Rank tribulation was still only D-Rank.
Meanwhile, the golden lightning continued descending and finally reached the next defensive position, where Luke had deliberately arranged two barriers to work together.

The first was "Sealed Celestial Citadel", whose purpose was to suppress the lightning's energy and remaining momentum through Sevaroth's Suppression Authority, while the second was "Closure Barrier", which had been placed beneath it to continuously repair any damage sustained by the stronger defense.

Luke had specifically chosen this arrangement because he believed that "Sealed Celestial Citadel", being a three-component Forged Art, would be capable of resisting the lightning for at least a few moments, allowing the Closure Barrier to repair its damaged structure during the collision.
And now, it was finally time to discover whether his plan would work.
KRRRRAAAAAK!!!

The golden lightning struck the Sealed Celestial Citadel, causing another violent clash of energies that sent an intense shockwave spreading across tens of kilometers, uprooting trees and destroying more of the surrounding terrain.
Even the few beasts that had been hiding underground became terrified by the tremendous force of the collision.
However, unlike the previous defenses, this barrier didn't immediately shatter upon impact.

Instead, the cosmic enclosure held its position against the lightning, while the Suppression Authority continued interfering with the attack's energy and the Closure Barrier repaired the damage forming across its structure.
For the first time since the tribulation began, Luke's defense was genuinely resisting the descending lightning rather than merely weakening it before being destroyed.
And this unexpected resistance seemed to anger Valtharion's golden eye.
However, even if Valtharion was displeased, it couldn't arbitrarily increase the strength of the tribulation, since the laws of the universe recognized ascension as a right belonging to every being.

Only the universe itself possessed the authority to interfere with that right, meaning that even Valtharion, despite being one of the worlds governed by those laws, was obligated to follow the established rules and administer the required test.
"Ugggh!"
Meanwhile, Luke was struggling to maintain his defenses, as the continuous clash was consuming an extraordinary amount of energy from his two Cosmic Hearts.

The Sealed Celestial Citadel required constant reinforcement to withstand the lightning, while the Closure Barrier was simultaneously consuming additional power to repair the damage appearing across the cosmic enclosure.
Despite the energy being continuously supplied, Luke could feel the strain increasing throughout his body.
He also noticed that five seconds had already passed since he activated Absolute Strength, leaving only half of its duration remaining.
Unfortunately, just as he was hoping the two barriers would endure for a little longer, an unpleasant sound suddenly reached his ears.
CRACK!

At first, the sound was faint, almost disappearing beneath the continuous collision of lightning and cosmic energy, but it soon became louder, forcing Luke to examine the condition of his defensive Arts.
What he discovered immediately made his expression change.
The "Closure Barrier", despite not directly withstanding the lightning's impact, had developed cracks across its entire structure and was already approaching its breaking point.
"Damn it!"
Luke cursed upon realizing that he had made another mistake during his preparations.

He had assumed that a defensive Art created from two components would be capable of supporting a stronger three-component Forged Art, without properly considering the difference between the forces they could endure.

It was practically the same as placing a wooden pillar beneath a thick iron roof while a gigantic hammer continuously struck it from above, since even if the roof remained intact, the weaker support would eventually collapse beneath the accumulated pressure.
And the result was exactly what Luke had feared.
SHATTER!

Of course, watching him wield so many extraordinary abilities made it easy to forget one important detail about his actual cultivation.
"A D Rank."
Zephyrielle quietly muttered those words, reminding herself that the being currently resisting an A-Rank tribulation was still only D-Rank.
Meanwhile, the golden lightning continued descending and finally reached the next defensive position, where Luke had deliberately arranged two barriers to work together.

The first was "Sealed Celestial Citadel", whose purpose was to suppress the lightning's energy and remaining momentum through Sevaroth's Suppression Authority, while the second was "Closure Barrier", which had been placed beneath it to continuously repair any damage sustained by the stronger defense.

Luke had specifically chosen this arrangement because he believed that "Sealed Celestial Citadel", being a three-component Forged Art, would be capable of resisting the lightning for at least a few moments, allowing the Closure Barrier to repair its damaged structure during the collision.
And now, it was finally time to discover whether his plan would work.
KRRRRAAAAAK!!!

The golden lightning struck the Sealed Celestial Citadel, causing another violent clash of energies that sent an intense shockwave spreading across tens of kilometers, uprooting trees and destroying more of the surrounding terrain.
Even the few beasts that had been hiding underground became terrified by the tremendous force of the collision.
However, unlike the previous defenses, this barrier didn't immediately shatter upon impact.

Instead, the cosmic enclosure held its position against the lightning, while the Suppression Authority continued interfering with the attack's energy and the Closure Barrier repaired the damage forming across its structure.
For the first time since the tribulation began, Luke's defense was genuinely resisting the descending lightning rather than merely weakening it before being destroyed.
And this unexpected resistance seemed to anger Valtharion's golden eye.
However, even if Valtharion was displeased, it couldn't arbitrarily increase the strength of the tribulation, since the laws of the universe recognized ascension as a right belonging to every being.

Only the universe itself possessed the authority to interfere with that right, meaning that even Valtharion, despite being one of the worlds governed by those laws, was obligated to follow the established rules and administer the required test.
"Ugggh!"
Meanwhile, Luke was struggling to maintain his defenses, as the continuous clash was consuming an extraordinary amount of energy from his two Cosmic Hearts.

The Sealed Celestial Citadel required constant reinforcement to withstand the lightning, while the Closure Barrier was simultaneously consuming additional power to repair the damage appearing across the cosmic enclosure.
Despite the energy being continuously supplied, Luke could feel the strain increasing throughout his body.
He also noticed that five seconds had already passed since he activated Absolute Strength, leaving only half of its duration remaining.
Unfortunately, just as he was hoping the two barriers would endure for a little longer, an unpleasant sound suddenly reached his ears.
CRACK!

At first, the sound was faint, almost disappearing beneath the continuous collision of lightning and cosmic energy, but it soon became louder, forcing Luke to examine the condition of his defensive Arts.
What he discovered immediately made his expression change.
The "Closure Barrier", despite not directly withstanding the lightning's impact, had developed cracks across its entire structure and was already approaching its breaking point.
"Damn it!"
Luke cursed upon realizing that he had made another mistake during his preparations.

He had assumed that a defensive Art created from two components would be capable of supporting a stronger three-component Forged Art, without properly considering the difference between the forces they could endure.

It was practically the same as placing a wooden pillar beneath a thick iron roof while a gigantic hammer continuously struck it from above, since even if the roof remained intact, the weaker support would eventually collapse beneath the accumulated pressure.
And the result was exactly what Luke had feared.
SHATTER!

chapters.title: Chapter 408: The Price of Surviving an A-Rank Heavenly Tribulation!
paragraphs: The Closure Barrier finally broke apart, its fractured structure scattering into fragments of energy before disappearing.
Luke could only sigh as he watched his repairing mechanism collapse, knowing that the Sealed Celestial Citadel would now have to withstand the remaining lightning without that assistance.
Unfortunately, even though he continued supplying energy, he couldn't repair the stronger barrier quickly enough to compensate for the damage it was receiving.
The next moment, its entire structure shattered.
BOOOOOOM!
Another powerful explosion erupted as the Sealed Celestial Citadel collapsed, sending a violent wave of energy toward the remaining defensive layers and even damaging the barrier beneath it.
However, Luke noticed something important amid the destruction.

The lightning's power had been reduced to approximately half of its original strength, meaning that although the remaining attack was still somewhat stronger than half A-Rank strike, it was no longer carrying its original full A-Rank force.
Upon realizing this, Luke's eyes lit up with renewed hope.
He immediately braced himself for the next impact, which arrived almost without giving him time to prepare.
BAMMM!

The golden lightning slammed into "Invisible Fortress" and shattered it without the slightest difficulty, proving that the concealment properties Luke had incorporated into the barrier were practically useless against Valtharion's tribulation.
Without slowing down, the attack continued descending until it finally reached the first defensive Art directly attached to Luke's giant body.
"Immovable Mountain"
BOOOOM!
The instant the lightning collided with his rocky armor, an extraordinary force surged through the entire structure, almost throwing Luke backward despite his strengthened Titan physique.
Fortunately, the Earthbound Authority incorporated into the Forged Art anchored him to the cliff, allowing him to resist the impact without immediately losing his position.
However, the same couldn't be said for the hill beneath him.
Unable to withstand the force being transferred through Luke's body, the entire summit shattered, causing the ground beneath his feet to collapse.
With his original position destroyed, Luke was left suspended in the air, while his golden-white halo flared with brilliant light as he struggled to maintain his defensive constructs.
Unfortunately, the physical impact wasn't the only danger carried by the tribulation.
At that moment, Luke suddenly felt a powerful mental attack strike his consciousness, immediately reminding him of the crimson chains that had bound him during the Orc ancestral technique.
Although this attack was weaker than what he had experienced back then, the familiar sensation still caused intense pain throughout his mind.
"Ughhhh!"
Luke cried out as the attack assaulted his consciousness, but before the mental damage could overwhelm him, his final defensive Art immediately activated.
"Unshaken Aegis"
The Iron Will Authority incorporated into the barrier reinforced his mental defenses, rapidly suppressing the incoming attack and reducing its effects to a level he could withstand.
"Huff!"
Luke began breathing heavily, realizing just how close that single mental attack had come to breaking his concentration.
Fortunately, he had prepared a defense specifically capable of resisting spiritual and mental interference, and he couldn't help feeling relieved that it had activated at the right moment.

He even regretted not possessing such protection during his earlier battle against the Orcs, since the mental effects of those crimson chains might have been considerably weaker if he had been able to resist them with Iron Will.
However, there was little point regretting the past, especially since everything had happened so quickly during that battle that he hadn't even been given an opportunity to prepare.
Luke quickly dismissed those thoughts and returned his attention to the remaining lightning, noticing that Absolute Strength had only two seconds left before its duration expired.
Worse still, the two defensive Arts protecting his body were already approaching their limits.
'If only I could create all of my defensive arts using three components...'

After witnessing the performance of the Sealed Celestial Citadel, Luke was convinced that properly constructed three-component defenses could possess strength approaching half of A-Rank, provided he selected the appropriate properties for each combination.
If he had been capable of creating and maintaining several such barriers, he believed the tribulation might have been completely exhausted before reaching his actual body.
Unfortunately, his current limits prevented him from accomplishing that.

Even with the support of his Cosmic Hearts, maintaining numerous two-component Forged Arts alongside a single three-component creation was already approaching the maximum amount of energy and concentration he could manage.
And before Luke could consider another solution—
CRACKKKKK!
The rocky armor surrounding his body finally cracked, its protective structure giving way beneath the remaining force of the tribulation.
The next instant, the golden lightning completely engulfed his body.
BOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOM!!!
The descending bolt struck Luke and carried him toward the ground, where the remaining energy erupted in a devastating explosion that destroyed everything within a fifty-kilometer radius.

An enormous crater formed at the center of the impact, while the resulting shockwave continued spreading beyond the destroyed area, uprooting distant trees and killing the beasts unfortunate enough to remain within its path.
Even after passing through every defensive layer Luke had prepared, the lightning still possessed destructive power exceeding Peak B-Rank.
"LUKE!!!"
Witnessing the explosion, both Rhaenyra and Emberlyn shouted in alarm before immediately launching themselves toward the impact site like cannonballs, desperate to reach him.
However, Zephyrielle's attention remained fixed upon the sky, where Valtharion's enormous golden eye appeared strangely dissatisfied.
It almost seemed angry, as though something it had expected to accomplish had failed.
'It failed?'
The thought astonished Zephyrielle, since throughout her long life, she had witnessed only a handful of beings survive Valtharion's wrath, and their number could practically be counted on one hand.
Moreover, what she had witnessed today hardly resembled an ordinary test, especially considering the extraordinary difference between Luke's cultivation and the power of the tribulation.
Yet somehow, that D-Rank Titan had survived.

Zephyrielle couldn't help feeling that Luke had now joined the very small number of beings capable of enduring Valtharion's wrath, although she remained unaware that he had already survived such an encounter once before.
This was actually his second time.
And deep within the newly formed crater, Luke himself also understood that he had survived.
Unfortunately, the price had been considerable.
His right hand was completely gone, while the palm of his left hand had also been destroyed, and numerous fractures covered the rest of his body.
Even so, a faint smile remained upon his injured face.
Luke's thoughts had already become groggy, and he could feel an overwhelming drowsiness gradually pulling him toward unconsciousness.
The sensation was even stronger than the sleep he had experienced earlier, while being transforming into a Titan, making it increasingly difficult to remain awake.
Through his fading consciousness, he suddenly heard two familiar voices calling from somewhere in the distance.
"LUKE!!!"
Hearing their worried cries, Luke couldn't help smiling again, although he was no longer capable of turning toward them.
His entire body was aching from the injuries he had sustained, while his Vorthar transformation was already beginning to revert to his normal human-sized appearance.
As his eyelids gradually closed, one final thought appeared in his mind.
'Seems... Like... I... Had... Made... My... Wife... Worr...'
Unfortunately, Luke couldn't even finish that thought before his consciousness completely faded, causing him to fall into a deep sleep.
And the instant he lost consciousness, something unexpected happened.
Pure darkness suddenly erupted from his body, expanding outward like an immense concentration of Void Energy until it formed a black, oval-shaped cocoon covering an area ten kilometers in diameter.
"Huh??"

Both Emberlyn and Rhaenyra immediately halted their movements upon seeing the sudden appearance of the darkness, becoming wary of the strange phenomenon that had emerged from the center of the crater.
However, the moment they remembered that Luke was still somewhere inside, their concern for his safety immediately overwhelmed their hesitation.
Without wasting another moment, both princesses prepared to enter the darkened area.
Unfortunately, before either of them could move forward, Zephyrielle suddenly appeared beside them.
"Calm down, my little princesses."
She gently grabbed both of their shoulders, stopping them from rushing toward the mysterious cocoon.
The two sisters immediately turned toward their grandmother, looking at her with confused expressions.
"Grandma, I have to save Luke, let me go."
Emberlyn spoke anxiously, clearly unwilling to remain outside while Luke was injured, and Rhaenyra immediately nodded in agreement.
However, Zephyrielle shook her head before looking toward the black cocoon again.
"It seems that your little lover had succeeded in what he was planning and this thing seems part of it."
"So if you do something wrong, then you may end up ruining his plan."
Hearing their grandmother's explanation, both Dragon Princesses gradually fell silent, understanding that interfering with the mysterious phenomenon might actually harm Luke rather than help him.
Although neither of them wanted to leave him alone in such a condition..
Eventually, both turned their attention toward the enormous black oval, knowing that Luke was still somewhere at its center.
"So I can't meet him?"
Emberlyn muttered those words with a saddened expression, clearly disappointed that she couldn't approach him even after witnessing how badly he had been injured.
Rhaenyra remained silent beside her, although her gaze continued lingering upon the dark cocoon, unwilling to look away from the place where Luke had disappeared.
And just like that, two months passed while the mysterious black cocoon remained undisturbed.
Until finally, after those two months, a crack appeared upon its surface from the inside.
