chapters.title: Chapter 409: After Two Months, the Titan Finally Awakens?!
paragraphs: 1st Day of Autumnus 11th Month, Year 50,001 — Dusk Era

Within the Lightning Valley, where dark thunderclouds could still be seen gathering overhead, an enormous black cocoon remained motionless at the center of the devastated landscape, showing no signs of activity even after two months.
The surrounding area was unusually silent, with only a few beasts occasionally appearing in the distance to observe the mysterious cocoon, although none dared to approach it.

After all, a dangerous woman was sitting upon the branch of a nearby tree, continuously releasing her draconic pressure into the surroundings, which was more than enough to discourage any curious creature from coming closer.
"Luke..."

Emberlyn quietly murmured his name, her voice carrying a sense of longing as she recalled the time they had spent together, especially his occasional jokes, laughter, and the companionship she had grown accustomed to during their journey.
"Hahhh..."

She released a sigh while looking toward the black cocoon, which had remained unchanged throughout the past two months, leaving her increasingly worried about Luke's condition and what might be happening to him inside.
However, just as she was thinking about him, the sound of powerful wings flapping suddenly echoed across the valley.
FWOOOSHHH!
A gigantic crimson dragon appeared above the surrounding hills, its arrival immediately frightening the beasts watching from afar and causing them to flee.
THUD!

Rhaenyra reverted to her humanoid form before landing a short distance from the tree where Emberlyn was sitting, then turned her attention toward the black cocoon without revealing any noticeable emotions.
At least, that was how her expression appeared to Emberlyn.

Unfortunately, seeing her elder sister's arrival didn't make Emberlyn particularly happy, especially since the longer she waited for Luke to awaken, the more she began questioning why Rhaenyra was the one married to him instead of her.

During the past two months, Rhaenyra had visited the valley only a few times to check Luke's condition, spending most of her time clearing the monsters throughout the Bravaryn region under their father's orders.
Emberlyn, on the other hand, had remained near the cocoon, waiting for Luke to return while her feelings toward him continued growing stronger.
And today, after keeping those thoughts to herself for so long, she finally decided to confront her elder sister.
"Rhaenyra, you should be happy now, that soon the chain connecting you to Luke will break, right?"
Hearing those words, Rhaenyra's expression darkened, and she turned toward Emberlyn, clearly unwilling to start another argument over her marriage.
Unfortunately, Emberlyn had no intention of letting the matter end there.
"You are selfish, Rhaenyra, not caring about Luke at all!"
Emberlyn shouted as she rose from the tree branch, staring at her elder sister with hatred that she had never openly displayed toward her before.

After all, Rhaenyra already knew that breaking the golden marriage chains would cause Luke to lose a portion of everything he possessed, including his talent, lifespan, and other aspects of his existence.
Yet despite knowing those consequences, she still intended to break them.
"I said earlier, that it's between him and me."
Rhaenyra responded firmly, making it clear that she didn't appreciate her younger sister interfering in something she considered a private matter.
"And yet you are hell-bent on taking everything from him!"

Emberlyn shouted again, becoming even angrier upon hearing her response, since she couldn't understand how Rhaenyra could claim that Luke belonged to her while preparing to do something that would harm him.
She had already promised herself that she would protect Luke, and if something happened to him again because she had failed to intervene, Emberlyn knew she would never forgive herself.
This time, Rhaenyra fully turned toward her younger sister, studying her expression with an unreadable gaze before narrowing her eyes.
"Don't tell me, Ember, that you have fallen for him completely.
"Yes, I am! As in the first place, it should have been me who was supposed to marry him!"
Emberlyn answered without hesitation, openly acknowledging her feelings for Luke rather than attempting to conceal them as she had done previously.
"But you are not, since I got married to him."
Rhaenyra immediately confronted her, stepping closer until the two sisters were standing directly before each other.
"Do you understand?"
However, Emberlyn refused to back down, meeting her elder sister's gaze without showing the slightest intention of retreating.
"But you don't accept this marriage at all."
"I said earlier, that it's a matter between u—"
CRACK!
Before Rhaenyra could finish speaking or Emberlyn could respond, a faint cracking sound suddenly reached their ears, immediately interrupting the argument.
Despite how quiet the sound was, both Dragon Princesses heard it clearly and instinctively turned toward the black cocoon.
Unlike its original appearance, the cocoon had gradually solidified throughout the past two months, developing a firm outer surface that had remained completely unchanged until now.
However, at the side facing them, a thin crack had finally appeared upon that dark surface, and it was slowly growing larger with every passing moment.
"Luke!!"
Both women shouted his name at almost the same time, immediately forgetting their previous argument as their attention shifted entirely toward the person inside.
After all, regardless of their disagreement, Luke had already become someone extremely important to both of them.
The same was true for Rhaenyra, who, despite constantly expressing her dislike toward the golden marriage chains, had gradually developed genuine feelings for Luke.
Unfortunately, those feelings hadn't changed her original decision, since she still intended to break the chains connecting them.

As far as she understood, Luke wouldn't die if his wives broke their marriage bonds, and although he would suffer considerable losses, she was already determined to compensate him for whatever he lost.
She would even take care of him afterward, ensuring that he wouldn't have to worry about anything.
After all, Luke belonged to her, and she had no intention of allowing anyone else to take him away.
However, that determination didn't mean she felt completely comfortable with what she was planning.
Deep down, Rhaenyra still carried a sense of guilt, which was precisely why she hadn't told Luke about the agreement concerning the golden chains that she had made with her father.
She also disliked hearing anyone else mention the matter, especially when Emberlyn continued reminding her of the consequences Luke would have to bear.
'Sorry, Luke. I hope you will understand that I can't live in chains.'
Rhaenyra silently apologized to him, knowing that he couldn't hear her thoughts, before returning her attention toward the cocoon.
By now, the original crack had spread across much of its surface, with smaller fractures continuously branching outward until the entire black structure appeared to be approaching its breaking point.
Both Dragon Princesses watched with growing anticipation, their earlier anger completely forgotten as they waited for the person they had missed throughout the past two months.
Finally, after several more moments, the cocoon could no longer maintain its form.
BOOOOM!
The black shell shattered apart, releasing a powerful shockwave that swept across the valley and destroyed the sparse vegetation that had managed to grow during the previous month.
However, instead of allowing the darkness to spread farther, the remaining energy suddenly began withdrawing toward the being concealed at the center.
The darkness originating from the shattered cocoon swirled inward, gathering around Luke's body before gradually merging with him.
As the surrounding shadows continued disappearing, a humanoid silhouette finally became visible within the fading darkness.
"Luke..."
Both princesses murmured his name with happiness upon recognizing his figure, relieved that he had finally emerged from the cocoon after remaining inside for so long.
For the moment, neither approached him, since the darkness was still merging with his body, and they didn't want to interrupt whatever process was taking place.
However, both were already eager to rush forward and embrace him as soon as it ended.
Unfortunately for Rhaenyra, her younger sister reacted first.
"Luke!"
With an excited shout, Emberlyn immediately launched herself forward, crossing the distance between them before Rhaenyra could even react.
Under her elder sister's astonished gaze, Emberlyn threw herself against Luke and wrapped her arms tightly around his body, completely ignoring the fact that his eyes were still closed.
She didn't even bother checking whether anything about him had changed during those two months, since all she cared about at that moment was finally being able to hold him again.
"This bi—! Tch!"
Rhaenyra abruptly stopped herself from cursing her own sister, although her expression made it obvious that she wasn't pleased by what had just happened.
Without wasting another moment, she took a step forward and instantly appeared beside them.
"Move."
Her voice was cold, leaving little doubt that she wanted Emberlyn to release Luke immediately.

Unfortunately, Emberlyn paid no attention to her command and continued embracing him, even burying her face against his body and breathing in his familiar scent, which she hadn't realized she had missed so much throughout their separation.
Seeing her younger sister behave this way, Rhaenyra almost felt as though she were looking at an entirely different person.
After all, Emberlyn had always possessed a rather quiet personality and rarely spoke more than necessary, yet ever since Luke entered their lives, she had gradually become more expressive.
She had started speaking much more frequently, openly arguing with her and even shouting whenever the matter involved Luke.
And now, she was shamelessly embracing and sniffing the scent of her husband right in front of her.
Of course, Rhaenyra still refused to acknowledge Luke as her husband, but that didn't make the sight any less irritating.
For a moment, she was completely speechless at her younger sister's behavior.
And she wasn't the only one.

High above the valley, Zephyrielle had been observing everything that happened after the cocoon shattered, including the argument between her two granddaughters and Emberlyn's enthusiastic reunion with Luke.
"Oh? It seems both my little princesses have fallen for a single person."
Zephyrielle made that observation with a smile, although whether it was truly a smile or concealed something else was something only she herself knew.
And the next instant, her figure disappeared from the sky.

During the past two months, Rhaenyra had visited the valley only a few times to check Luke's condition, spending most of her time clearing the monsters throughout the Bravaryn region under their father's orders.
Emberlyn, on the other hand, had remained near the cocoon, waiting for Luke to return while her feelings toward him continued growing stronger.
And today, after keeping those thoughts to herself for so long, she finally decided to confront her elder sister.
"Rhaenyra, you should be happy now, that soon the chain connecting you to Luke will break, right?"
Hearing those words, Rhaenyra's expression darkened, and she turned toward Emberlyn, clearly unwilling to start another argument over her marriage.
Unfortunately, Emberlyn had no intention of letting the matter end there.
"You are selfish, Rhaenyra, not caring about Luke at all!"
Emberlyn shouted as she rose from the tree branch, staring at her elder sister with hatred that she had never openly displayed toward her before.

After all, Rhaenyra already knew that breaking the golden marriage chains would cause Luke to lose a portion of everything he possessed, including his talent, lifespan, and other aspects of his existence.
Yet despite knowing those consequences, she still intended to break them.
"I said earlier, that it's between him and me."
Rhaenyra responded firmly, making it clear that she didn't appreciate her younger sister interfering in something she considered a private matter.
"And yet you are hell-bent on taking everything from him!"

Emberlyn shouted again, becoming even angrier upon hearing her response, since she couldn't understand how Rhaenyra could claim that Luke belonged to her while preparing to do something that would harm him.
She had already promised herself that she would protect Luke, and if something happened to him again because she had failed to intervene, Emberlyn knew she would never forgive herself.
This time, Rhaenyra fully turned toward her younger sister, studying her expression with an unreadable gaze before narrowing her eyes.
"Don't tell me, Ember, that you have fallen for him completely.
"Yes, I am!
As in the first place, it should have been me who was supposed to marry him!"
Emberlyn answered without hesitation, openly acknowledging her feelings for Luke rather than attempting to conceal them as she had done previously.
"But you are not, since I got married to him."
Rhaenyra immediately confronted her, stepping closer until the two sisters were standing directly before each other.
"Do you understand?"
However, Emberlyn refused to back down, meeting her elder sister's gaze without showing the slightest intention of retreating.
"But you don't accept this marriage at all."
"I said earlier, that it's a matter between u—"
CRACK!
Before Rhaenyra could finish speaking or Emberlyn could respond, a faint cracking sound suddenly reached their ears, immediately interrupting the argument.
Despite how quiet the sound was, both Dragon Princesses heard it clearly and instinctively turned toward the black cocoon.
Unlike its original appearance, the cocoon had gradually solidified throughout the past two months, developing a firm outer surface that had remained completely unchanged until now.
However, at the side facing them, a thin crack had finally appeared upon that dark surface, and it was slowly growing larger with every passing moment.
"Luke!!"
Both women shouted his name at almost the same time, immediately forgetting their previous argument as their attention shifted entirely toward the person inside.
After all, regardless of their disagreement, Luke had already become someone extremely important to both of them.
The same was true for Rhaenyra, who, despite constantly expressing her dislike toward the golden marriage chains, had gradually developed genuine feelings for Luke.
Unfortunately, those feelings hadn't changed her original decision, since she still intended to break the chains connecting them.

As far as she understood, Luke wouldn't die if his wives broke their marriage bonds, and although he would suffer considerable losses, she was already determined to compensate him for whatever he lost.
She would even take care of him afterward, ensuring that he wouldn't have to worry about anything.
After all, Luke belonged to her, and she had no intention of allowing anyone else to take him away.
However, that determination didn't mean she felt completely comfortable with what she was planning.
Deep down, Rhaenyra still carried a sense of guilt, which was precisely why she hadn't told Luke about the agreement concerning the golden chains that she had made with her father.
She also disliked hearing anyone else mention the matter, especially when Emberlyn continued reminding her of the consequences Luke would have to bear.
'Sorry, Luke.
I hope you will understand that I can't live in chains.'
Rhaenyra silently apologized to him, knowing that he couldn't hear her thoughts, before returning her attention toward the cocoon.
By now, the original crack had spread across much of its surface, with smaller fractures continuously branching outward until the entire black structure appeared to be approaching its breaking point.
Both Dragon Princesses watched with growing anticipation, their earlier anger completely forgotten as they waited for the person they had missed throughout the past two months.
Finally, after several more moments, the cocoon could no longer maintain its form.
BOOOOM!
The black shell shattered apart, releasing a powerful shockwave that swept across the valley and destroyed the sparse vegetation that had managed to grow during the previous month.
However, instead of allowing the darkness to spread farther, the remaining energy suddenly began withdrawing toward the being concealed at the center.
The darkness originating from the shattered cocoon swirled inward, gathering around Luke's body before gradually merging with him.
As the surrounding shadows continued disappearing, a humanoid silhouette finally became visible within the fading darkness.
"Luke..."
Both princesses murmured his name with happiness upon recognizing his figure, relieved that he had finally emerged from the cocoon after remaining inside for so long.
For the moment, neither approached him, since the darkness was still merging with his body, and they didn't want to interrupt whatever process was taking place.
However, both were already eager to rush forward and embrace him as soon as it ended.
Unfortunately for Rhaenyra, her younger sister reacted first.
"Luke!"
With an excited shout, Emberlyn immediately launched herself forward, crossing the distance between them before Rhaenyra could even react.
Under her elder sister's astonished gaze, Emberlyn threw herself against Luke and wrapped her arms tightly around his body, completely ignoring the fact that his eyes were still closed.
She didn't even bother checking whether anything about him had changed during those two months, since all she cared about at that moment was finally being able to hold him again.
"This bi—!
Tch!"
Rhaenyra abruptly stopped herself from cursing her own sister, although her expression made it obvious that she wasn't pleased by what had just happened.
Without wasting another moment, she took a step forward and instantly appeared beside them.
"Move."
Her voice was cold, leaving little doubt that she wanted Emberlyn to release Luke immediately.

Unfortunately, Emberlyn paid no attention to her command and continued embracing him, even burying her face against his body and breathing in his familiar scent, which she hadn't realized she had missed so much throughout their separation.
Seeing her younger sister behave this way, Rhaenyra almost felt as though she were looking at an entirely different person.
After all, Emberlyn had always possessed a rather quiet personality and rarely spoke more than necessary, yet ever since Luke entered their lives, she had gradually become more expressive.
She had started speaking much more frequently, openly arguing with her and even shouting whenever the matter involved Luke.
And now, she was shamelessly embracing and sniffing the scent of her husband right in front of her.
Of course, Rhaenyra still refused to acknowledge Luke as her husband, but that didn't make the sight any less irritating.
For a moment, she was completely speechless at her younger sister's behavior.
And she wasn't the only one.

High above the valley, Zephyrielle had been observing everything that happened after the cocoon shattered, including the argument between her two granddaughters and Emberlyn's enthusiastic reunion with Luke.
"Oh?
It seems both my little princesses have fallen for a single person."
Zephyrielle made that observation with a smile, although whether it was truly a smile or concealed something else was something only she herself knew.
And the next instant, her figure disappeared from the sky.

chapters.title: Chapter 410: Three Beauties, One Naked Titan, and a Terrible Misunderstanding!
paragraphs: Luke remained motionless within Emberlyn's embrace, and after several moments, his eyelids slowly lifted as his consciousness began recovering from the exhaustion of his breakthrough.

The first thing he noticed was the softness pressing against his bare chest, which reminded him that his magical clothes had been completely destroyed, leaving him naked from head to toe, with even his little brother exposed.
However, despite having such a beautiful woman hugging him, his body showed absolutely no reaction, something that would ordinarily have surprised or excited him considerably more than it did now.
'Ember...'

Recognizing the familiar presence, Luke gradually became more alert, although he neither returned her embrace nor attempted to move away, simply allowing her to continue hugging him while his arms rested loosely at his sides.
His attention then shifted toward Rhaenyra, who stood nearby watching him, and the moment he recognized his supposed third wife, Luke noticed something peculiar about his own reaction.
'Rhaenyra...'

Usually, whenever he encountered one of his wives, certain emotions would surface within him regardless of what he actually felt toward them, sometimes becoming so strong that distinguishing his genuine feelings from those imposed upon him was almost impossible.
Yet looking at Rhaenyra now, he couldn't feel that familiar influence.
'No, there is.'
Luke examined his inner state more carefully, and although his outward expression remained unchanged, he soon discovered something that made him reconsider everything he had initially assumed.
'I have changed.'

For the first time, he could observe his own emotions from a perspective completely separate from the consciousness experiencing them, almost as though he were standing outside himself and watching another person's thoughts.
And what he discovered was rather disturbing.

Deep within his body, Luke could see an image resembling his former self, restrained by the familiar golden chains that had once influenced his emotions, although their appearance had changed considerably.
Mysterious black-and-white symbols now covered the chains around his heart, and whenever his former self tried to move, those restraints responded like the strings of a puppet.

At that very moment, the figure was struggling to approach Rhaenyra, desperately wanting to embrace the wife he hadn't seen for so long, but an invisible boundary prevented it from carrying out that desire.

Luke could clearly observe the struggle without experiencing any urge to intervene, and as he watched the chains attempting to control his former self, he gradually understood what his breakthrough had accomplished.
The chains were still functioning as before, manipulating the emotions they had been created to influence, but his present consciousness now existed beyond their reach.
In other words, he had become the true puppeteer of his own existence, while the restraints continued struggling to control a puppet that no longer possessed any authority over him.
'Means I have full control over my emotions—or in short, I have become emotionless, and emotions are now just tools for me, like ornaments.
Strangely enough, even this discovery failed to produce any particular excitement.
Everything seemed strangely unimportant, including the emotions he had previously considered part of himself.
However, when he returned his attention to Rhaenyra and saw the complicated expression upon her face, he began wondering whether living with such complete detachment would actually be enjoyable.
'Sigh, why am I thinking like those gods from the story?'
Mocking his own thoughts, Luke decided there was little point in deliberately suppressing his emotions when he could simply allow himself to experience them whenever he wished.
With that decision, he loosened his control and allowed his body to behave naturally again, although his expression remained almost unchanged as he looked toward Rhaenyra.

Having been distracted by his internal discovery, Luke had nearly forgotten about Emberlyn, who was still embracing him, and was about to greet his third wife when an unfamiliar voice suddenly interrupted him.
"Hel—"
"Darling, why are you with other women~"
The seductive voice came from directly behind Luke, startling him and the two dragon princesses, who immediately turned toward its source.
Before anyone could react, a beautiful woman materialized behind him and casually wrapped her arms around his neck, pressing herself against his back as though she had every right to embrace him.
Both Emberlyn and Rhaenyra stared at the newcomer, momentarily distracted from her unexpected behavior by her extraordinary appearance.

The woman looked to be in her mid-twenties, standing approximately six feet tall, with flawless porcelain-white skin, a slender waist, beautifully proportioned curves, and an elegance that made her breathtaking beauty even more captivating.

Her long, silky jet-black hair flowed down her back until it nearly reached her knees, while her exquisite face possessed delicate features, naturally rosy lips, and an alluring smile that carried a distinctly mischievous charm.

However, her most unusual features were her eyes, which were entirely pitch-black without the slightest trace of white, while several delicate golden circles surrounded her pupils and slowly revolved within their mysterious depths.

She wore an elegant deep-burgundy gown embroidered with intricate black-and-golden patterns, complemented by a black gemstone necklace and delicate golden ornaments that suited her appearance beautifully.

And despite possessing such an enchanting appearance, the woman was currently looking at Luke with an aggrieved expression, behaving like a wife who had just discovered her husband entertaining other women behind her back.
'Who is she? And how did she appear behind me?'

Luke couldn't understand how someone had suddenly appeared behind him without his noticing, especially when she was now embracing him so intimately, but before he could ask anything, Emberlyn's furious voice interrupted his thoughts.
"Luke! How could you cheat on me!"
Emberlyn immediately loosened her embrace and looked between Luke and the mysterious woman, her expression filled with indignation as though she had personally caught her lover being unfaithful.
Luke stared at her in disbelief, while Rhaenyra turned toward her younger sister with an equally bewildered expression.
'Woman, hear your own words? Cheat? Are we even in love?'
For a moment, Luke genuinely wondered whether Emberlyn had forgotten the actual nature of their relationship, especially when she was accusing him with such confidence.
Rhaenyra found her younger sister's behavior equally unreasonable, although for a slightly different reason.
'Ember, what cheat? You haven't even proposed to him, so he is not your lover.'
She looked at Emberlyn's furious expression, wondering how someone who hadn't even properly confessed her feelings could suddenly behave as though Luke had betrayed their marriage.
'And you are shouting like he is your husband and you had cat—'
Her thoughts stopped abruptly when she remembered something that completely changed her perspective on the situation.
'Damn it! Luke is not Ember's husband, but he is my husband!'

Rhaenyra immediately turned toward Luke, and before he could understand the sudden change in her expression, she raised her voice with an accusation that sounded remarkably similar to her younger sister's.
"Luke, you dare to cheat on me!"

Luke looked at Rhaenyra, then at Emberlyn, finding himself caught between two women who were now accusing him of the same thing, even though neither had previously behaved as though they wanted to acknowledge their relationship with him.
Emberlyn was no less bewildered by her elder sister's unexpected outburst, particularly because Rhaenyra had repeatedly refused to accept Luke as her husband.
'Sister, you weren't accepting him as your husband, so why the sudden cheat claim? It is me who got cheated.'

However, Emberlyn wasn't about to argue with Rhaenyra over that particular matter, especially when the beautiful stranger was still clinging to Luke from behind, so she turned toward him again and continued demanding an explanation through her expression.

chapters.title: Chapter 411: “What the World Forgets, the Void Remembers.”
paragraphs: Meanwhile, Luke could hardly believe the situation he had found himself in immediately after completing his breakthrough.
'Dare?? You hadn't even let me touch you or even call you wife, but now, seeing me with another beautiful woman, you are saying I dare to cheat on you???'

He wanted to ask both women whether they had somehow forgotten everything that had happened between them previously, but seeing their equally aggrieved expressions, he suspected that attempting to reason with them would only make matters worse.

Thus, an awkward silence settled over the three of them, with Emberlyn and Rhaenyra glaring at Luke as though he had committed some unforgivable betrayal, while the mysterious woman remained comfortably wrapped around his neck.

And judging by the mischievous smile spreading across her beautiful face, she was thoroughly enjoying the misunderstanding she had created, particularly now that both dragon princesses had become so preoccupied with accusing Luke that neither had even thought to question who she was.

The awkward silence was finally interrupted when another woman appeared beside the group, drawing everyone's attention toward her, although unlike the seductive beauty who had caused the misunderstanding, this newcomer possessed a gentle, elder-sister charm that made her presence remarkably comforting.

She appeared to be in her mid-twenties, with a graceful, slender figure, exquisitely delicate facial features, and flawless pale-golden skin that radiated a faint warmth, giving her an almost divine beauty.

Her long, silky hair cascaded down to her waist, shimmering with shades of silver-white, gold, and soft purple that resembled flowing starlight, while her magnificent eyes contained two miniature galaxies filled with countless slowly revolving stars.
An elegant white-and-golden gown draped naturally over her figure, completing an appearance that immediately distinguished her from the mischievous black-haired woman.
"Ryve, don't disturb him."

Speaking in a gentle but slightly admonishing tone, the newcomer stepped beside Luke and removed Ryve's arms from his neck before turning toward him and the two dragon princesses with an apologetic smile.
However, when her gaze returned to Luke, her smile briefly grew warmer, although she quickly concealed it before taking hold of Ryve again.
"Sorry for you; my sister is mischievous and likes to play pranks on people, so please forgive us."
"No! I want to play with him; you guys were playing with him all the time."
Ryve immediately protested, clearly unwilling to leave when she had only just begun enjoying the trouble she had caused, but the golden-skinned woman had no intention of allowing her to continue.
"Shush! Let's go!"
Without giving her another opportunity to cling to Luke, she dragged the reluctant Ryve away, and before the three could properly react, both women had disappeared into the surrounding wilderness.
Emberlyn and Rhaenyra stared toward the direction they had gone, temporarily forgetting their earlier accusations as they struggled to understand what had just happened.

After all, two unfamiliar women whose beauty could rival even their grandmother's had appeared out of nowhere, behaved as though they knew Luke intimately, and then departed without explaining anything.
Luke was equally bewildered, although unlike the dragon princesses, he had managed to recognize the golden-skinned woman.
'Caelith? How did she appear in human form? And who was the earlier woman, whom she called sister?'
He had never seen Caelith manifest such a body before, and the fact that she had addressed the mysterious woman as her sister only raised further questions about the identity of the newcomer.
However, knowing that he could investigate those matters later, Luke shifted his attention toward the changes he had undergone during his breakthrough.
"Hmm."

He slowly clenched his fist, concentrating on the physical strength contained within his reconstructed body, and discovered that his basic attributes were approximately equivalent to those of an Early B-Rank being.
This result left him somewhat confused, because after successfully creating his unique C-Rank Titan body, he had expected a greater increase in physical strength.

Of course, he hadn't expected to receive all the enhancements normally associated with his Titan transformations, but even among beings of the same cultivation realm, a giant generally possessed considerably greater physical strength than an ordinary human because of its larger physique.

Considering the extraordinary nature of his Eternal Titan body, Luke had assumed that its fundamental physical attributes would reflect a similar advantage, yet the strength he currently felt didn't seem to match those expectations.
'Seems like I have to check the system.'

With that thought, Luke turned his attention toward another ability he had gained from his breakthrough, and under the curious gazes of Emberlyn and Rhaenyra, his blue eyes suddenly turned pitch-black.
"AUTHORITY OF THE BLACK CHRONICLE"

The moment he activated the fifth ability of Nyx, his Void Titan, Luke felt his energy reserves draining at an alarming rate, while the colors of the surrounding world rapidly faded until everything before him appeared in black and white.

Before he could properly examine the strange change, images of earlier events began appearing throughout his vision, moving in rapid succession as though someone were replaying the past at an accelerated speed, complete with the sounds and conversations that had accompanied those moments.

Among the reconstructed scenes, Luke noticed two figures standing near each other, although their bodies were completely black and blurry, making them almost impossible to distinguish from their surroundings.

One of the figures appeared to be speaking, but the words reached him as incomprehensible gibberish, and when the second figure responded, their subsequent movements suggested that the conversation had nearly escalated into a fight.

However, just as they seemed about to confront each other, both figures suddenly stopped and turned toward the location where Luke had been undergoing his breakthrough, before hurrying in that direction.
'Hmm, so the two figures were Ember and Rhaenyra.'

Having recognized them from their movements and the direction they had taken, Luke deactivated the Authority, causing the surrounding world to regain its colors while his eyes returned to their original blue.
He glanced toward Emberlyn, who was still standing close to him, before looking at Rhaenyra, wondering what the two sisters could possibly have been discussing before they rushed toward him.
'What did they talk about to almost fight each other?'

Although the possibility of discovering their conversation intrigued him, Luke decided not to investigate further for now and instead summoned the System information concerning his newly awakened ability.
[FORBIDDEN ABILITY UNLOCKED]
Titan: Nyx — The Void Titan
Ability: Fifth
Unlock Rank: C-Rank
Name: "AUTHORITY OF THE BLACK CHRONICLE"
Type: Forbidden Authority
Status: Awakened
[DESCRIPTION]
The Void is an eternal witness, preserving traces of events, existences, and phenomena that have passed through its influence.
The Authority of the Black Chronicle grants the wielder the power to perceive, preserve, reconstruct, and examine these records.
Through the Chronicle, events that have already occurred may be recovered and observed without altering the past.
[CORE FUNCTIONS]
1. "VOID MEMORY"
The wielder can perceive residual Void traces left behind by past events.
These traces may reveal the movements of individuals, supernatural phenomena, battles, deaths, destruction, and other significant occurrences.
The clarity of recovered information depends on the remaining traces and the wielder's strength.
2. "HISTORICAL RECONSTRUCTION"
The wielder can reconstruct past events from their preserved Void traces.
Recovered events may be displayed as three-dimensional projections, allowing the wielder to observe movements, surroundings, interactions, and the sequence of actions.
The reconstruction may be examined repeatedly from different perspectives wherever sufficient information exists.
3. "FORBIDDEN CHRONICLE"
The wielder can permanently preserve recovered or personally witnessed events within the Black Chronicle.
Stored records may be accessed, replayed, examined, and compared whenever desired.
Storage Capacity: Unknown.
4. "TECHNIQUE REVELATION"
By examining the historical manifestation of a technique, the wielder can study its activation process, energy movements, structural changes, and execution sequence.
This allows the analysis of unfamiliar combat techniques, magical formations, and supernatural abilities.
The Chronicle does not automatically grant the ability to reproduce what it reveals.
5. "CHRONICLE PROJECTION"
The wielder can manifest stored historical records as three-dimensional projections visible to others.
These projections may be used to demonstrate past events, reveal hidden incidents, examine battles, or share recorded information.
The projections reproduce information rather than physically recreating the original events.
6. "ANCIENT ECHOES"
The wielder may examine surviving Void traces belonging to events from the distant past.
Ancient battlefields, abandoned civilizations, destroyed structures, and forgotten locations may contain recoverable historical information.
As cultivation increases, the Authority becomes capable of reconstructing increasingly distant and complicated events.
[CURRENT LIMITATIONS — C-RANK]
Historical Reach:
Dependent on cultivation, residual trace preservation, and Void Energy.
Reconstruction Accuracy:
Dependent on the quantity and integrity of available information in the Void.
Energy Consumption:
Increases with historical distance, event complexity, and reconstruction scale.
Incomplete Records:
Missing historical information cannot be reconstructed with guaranteed accuracy.
Concealment:
Certain supernatural protections may interfere with the examination of historical traces.
Time Manipulation:
None. The Chronicle observes and reconstructs the past without changing it.
Future Observation:
Unavailable.
[FORBIDDEN LAW]
"What the world forgets, the Void remembers."

However, when her gaze returned to Luke, her smile briefly grew warmer, although she quickly concealed it before taking hold of Ryve again.
"Sorry for you; my sister is mischievous and likes to play pranks on people, so please forgive us."
"No!
I want to play with him; you guys were playing with him all the time."
Ryve immediately protested, clearly unwilling to leave when she had only just begun enjoying the trouble she had caused, but the golden-skinned woman had no intention of allowing her to continue.
"Shush!
Let's go!"
Without giving her another opportunity to cling to Luke, she dragged the reluctant Ryve away, and before the three could properly react, both women had disappeared into the surrounding wilderness.
Emberlyn and Rhaenyra stared toward the direction they had gone, temporarily forgetting their earlier accusations as they struggled to understand what had just happened.

After all, two unfamiliar women whose beauty could rival even their grandmother's had appeared out of nowhere, behaved as though they knew Luke intimately, and then departed without explaining anything.
Luke was equally bewildered, although unlike the dragon princesses, he had managed to recognize the golden-skinned woman.
'Caelith?
How did she appear in human form?
And who was the earlier woman, whom she called sister?'
He had never seen Caelith manifest such a body before, and the fact that she had addressed the mysterious woman as her sister only raised further questions about the identity of the newcomer.
However, knowing that he could investigate those matters later, Luke shifted his attention toward the changes he had undergone during his breakthrough.
"Hmm."

He slowly clenched his fist, concentrating on the physical strength contained within his reconstructed body, and discovered that his basic attributes were approximately equivalent to those of an Early B-Rank being.
This result left him somewhat confused, because after successfully creating his unique C-Rank Titan body, he had expected a greater increase in physical strength.

Of course, he hadn't expected to receive all the enhancements normally associated with his Titan transformations, but even among beings of the same cultivation realm, a giant generally possessed considerably greater physical strength than an ordinary human because of its larger physique.

Considering the extraordinary nature of his Eternal Titan body, Luke had assumed that its fundamental physical attributes would reflect a similar advantage, yet the strength he currently felt didn't seem to match those expectations.
'Seems like I have to check the system.'

With that thought, Luke turned his attention toward another ability he had gained from his breakthrough, and under the curious gazes of Emberlyn and Rhaenyra, his blue eyes suddenly turned pitch-black.
"AUTHORITY OF THE BLACK CHRONICLE"

The moment he activated the fifth ability of Nyx, his Void Titan, Luke felt his energy reserves draining at an alarming rate, while the colors of the surrounding world rapidly faded until everything before him appeared in black and white.

Before he could properly examine the strange change, images of earlier events began appearing throughout his vision, moving in rapid succession as though someone were replaying the past at an accelerated speed, complete with the sounds and conversations that had accompanied those moments.

Among the reconstructed scenes, Luke noticed two figures standing near each other, although their bodies were completely black and blurry, making them almost impossible to distinguish from their surroundings.

One of the figures appeared to be speaking, but the words reached him as incomprehensible gibberish, and when the second figure responded, their subsequent movements suggested that the conversation had nearly escalated into a fight.

However, just as they seemed about to confront each other, both figures suddenly stopped and turned toward the location where Luke had been undergoing his breakthrough, before hurrying in that direction.
'Hmm, so the two figures were Ember and Rhaenyra.'

Having recognized them from their movements and the direction they had taken, Luke deactivated the Authority, causing the surrounding world to regain its colors while his eyes returned to their original blue.
He glanced toward Emberlyn, who was still standing close to him, before looking at Rhaenyra, wondering what the two sisters could possibly have been discussing before they rushed toward him.
'What did they talk about to almost fight each other?'

Although the possibility of discovering their conversation intrigued him, Luke decided not to investigate further for now and instead summoned the System information concerning his newly awakened ability.
